facts.fact: The January 2019 action plan of the Stratégie Nationale de Promotion du Haut Débit lists actions by theme with phasing and a preliminary calendar (one action to launch in September 2019) and leaves the fiches to be completed by a follow-up committee, but the passages state no adoption and no broadband coverage, speed or price target.
